experiment.name: cgc-observability-boundary-v1
experiment.role: exploratory train-geometry physical observability boundary screen
experiment.question: At what spatial code separation and counterfeit-to-authentic power ratio does clock-centered correlator geometry become distinguishable from a marginally matched independent multipath control?

grid.zero_db_excluded_reason: equal-power prompt ownership is ambiguous in the dominant-component approximation

generator.tracking_model: the stronger component owns the prompt; the weaker component is represented as a signed secondary path
generator.nuisance_pairing: direction, center, phase, noise, and PRN derangement are identical across every grid cell for the same geometry and event index
generator.multipath_control: exact PRN derangement of the complete complex profile and estimated-delay multiset within every event

evaluation.boundary_definition: minimum spatial separation satisfying every observable-cell rule at each power advantage

data_boundary.geometry_source_policy: reuse and hash-verify only the six LOS tables pinned by the template config

claim_boundary: ideal triangular-autocorrelation complex-nine-tap mechanism screen and RF-anchor selection only; not a receiver-RF, field, TEXBAT, or operational detector validation
